claude_proposed_widenings.name: alter_terrain
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Move Earth's core effect is reshaping physical terrain — raising/lowering elevation, forming trenches, walls, pillars in existing dirt/sand/clay. No v4 atom covers this. create_object is semantically wrong (no new object is conjured; existing terrain is geometrically deformed). alter_terrain would name the effect of mutating world-geometry in place.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration. You can raise or lower the area's elevation, create or fill in a trench, erect or flatten a wall, or form a pillar.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation (kind: terrain_reshape)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ongoing_effect family would structurally fit Move Earth (concentration, area attachment, timed duration) if OngoingOperation had a terrain_reshape variant. Currently only roll_modifier and damage_on_hit exist; neither covers area terrain manipulation. A terrain_reshape operation referencing the new alter_terrain atom would close the gap.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: periodic re-targeting within concentration (window or mechanism variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Move Earth lets the caster choose a new 40-foot area every 10 minutes of concentration. This is a periodic re-targeting mechanic with no analogue in the current atom set. No existing window atom (post_action_window, turn_start_window, rest_window, etc.) maps to 'end of every 10 minutes of concentration'. A periodic_concentration_window or a duration_interval sub-mechanism would be needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: At the end of every 10 minutes you spend Concentrating on the spell, you can choose a new area of terrain to affect within range.
